text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: `az14-network-fabric-high-error-rate` fired (P1) — PD-98765. Observed packet drops and control-plane flaps in az14 affecting routing to serving pools. Automatic fallback policies triggered.

pagerduty: Pager acknowledged by Maya (SRE) — escalation to SRE lead in 5m if not resolved.

Maya: Acked. I'm on it, adding Luis and Owen.

Luis: seeing a spike in 502/timeout from az14 -> our ingress logs show rapid connection resets to shards: `serve-pool-az14-[a-c]`. Repro window ~ 01:12:30 -> now.

Owen: Confirmed. BGP flaps on the fabric side, intermittent L2 errors reported by the region agent. Net team pinged.

Maya: Eng-runtime, do we have fast failover routes ready? Can we divert traffic off az14 to az12/az13?

eng-runtime: We have a routing-divert playbook. Can run `rbw route-divert --from az14 --to az12,az13 --policy graceful --drain 30s`. Doing a plan now.

Nidhi: CS note — customers in EU region are reporting elevated token-latency and some generation failures. Early estimate: ~5-8% of hosted API calls erroring for EU tenants pinned to az14. CSMs looped.

Maya: Initiating controlled divert to reduce customer impact. Running the command and will watch KPIs.

eng-runtime: plan looks good. Command I'm about to run:

```
# dry-run shows expected drain and failover
rbw route-divert --from az14 --to az12,az13 --policy graceful --drain 30s --confirm
```

Maya: Running confirm now.

incident-bot: `route-divert` executed by eng-runtime at 01:18:04 UTC. Changes pushed to control plane.

Owen: Net team reports persistent link errors even after divert started, some flow sessions still pinned to az14 due to sticky routing. Working with infra to purge sticky session entries.

Luis: KPIs — 502s drop from 6.3% -> 2.0% within 90s of divert start, p95 latency for EU generation down ~220ms. Still seeing a small tail.

Maya: Good improvement. Keep monitor and throttle new deploys to avoid extra load. Triggering canary rollback guard.

pagerduty: PD note: escalation cancelled — incident still active but mitigated, PD state moved to acknowledged->stable-watching.

Nidhi: Notifying top 10 impacted customers. Drafting short message: "We detected a routing issue in AZ14 causing intermittent errors; traffic has been diverted and services are recovering. We're monitoring — will follow up with timeline and RCA."

csm-alex: Please add ETA for RCA and whether dedicated customers on reserved capacity were affected differently. I will send to customers once I have that.

Maya: Quick check: Dedicated pools in az14 saw connection resets but most had automatic fallback to sibling AZs per config. We flagged two Dedicated customers with pinned nodes — reaching out.

eng-runtime: We're initiating a soft-restart of the az14 routing agent to clear stale sessions: `systemctl restart redwood-routing-agent` on control plane nodes in az14. Schedule says 01:22 UTC.

Owen: Net team cleared ~70% of sticky sessions after restart. Traffic moved cleanly. Remaining sessions will drain in next 2 minutes.

Luis: Metrics now: EU errors at 0.9%, p95 latency returned to baseline. No customer-facing errors in past 60s for most tenants.

Maya: Good. Switching to monitoring mode. I'll keep this thread live for handoff.

incident-bot: Autopager: will close if no new high-severity alerts related to PD-98765 in 15m.

Maya: Handoff to SRE-oncall for continued watch — @sre-oncall you'll own post-mitigation checks and RCA kick-off.

sre-oncall: On it. I'll collect logs, timelines, and open RCA ticket. Tentative RCA meeting in 24h.

Nidhi: Customer message sent to impacted customers; 2 customers asked for more details — csm-alex to coordinate followups.

eng-runtime: Postmortem checklist: capture `tcpdump` from ingress, routing-agent logs, control-plane telemetry, and diversion audit. I'm snapshotting configs now.

Maya: Thanks. Final note: keep deploy freeze in EU for 30m. If anything spikes, re-escalate PD.

Luis: Adding link to quick metrics dash: https://monitoring.redwood.internal/d/az14/route-failures (internal)

Owen: Net ticket #NET-4421 created for fabric vendor follow-up.

incident-bot: Incident update: mitigation complete, PD-98765 moved to resolved-provisionally at 01:34:00 UTC pending RCA.

Maya: Closing thread to new replies after handoff. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
